lines.t: Verse 1
Son, I’ve walked down broken roads,
Chased dreams that turned to dust.
But the Lord, He pulled me home again,
And taught my heart to trust.
Now when the winds of life blow hard,
And you don’t know what to do,
Say, “Yes, Lord,” with all your heart,
He will carry you through.
Chorus
Blessed are the ones who answer, “Yes, Lord,”
When the darkness fills their way.
Blessed are the ones who pray, “Your will be done,”
And walk in faith each day.
Blessed are the hearts that whisper, “Amen,”
Through laughter and through scars.
You’ll find peace, my child, in knowing —
He is who He says He is.
Verse 2
Son, I’ve learned from every fall,
Grace can mend a soul.
It’s not the strength that makes a man,
But the One who makes him whole.
When the world tells you to go your way,
Remember what is true—
The wisest words I ever spoke
Were, “Lord, I trust in You.”
(Repeat Chorus)
Blessed are the ones who answer, “Yes, Lord,”
When the darkness fills their way.
Blessed are the ones who pray, “Your will be done,”
And walk in faith each day.
Blessed are the hearts that whisper, “Amen,”
Through laughter and through scars.
You’ll find peace, my child, in knowing —
He is who He says He is.
Bridge
There’s freedom when you lay it down,
Your plans, your pride, your fear.
Mature faith isn’t easy, son,
But the truth is always near.
Final Chorus
So say, “Yes, Lord,” when your time comes,
And trust His guiding hand.
Pray “Your will be done, Lord,” son,
And you will understand.
Keep “Amen, Lord,” in every breath,
Through joy and trial alike.
For You’ll find peace, my son, in knowing —
He is who He says He is,
And His word is your life.
